snippet.title: HIPS N NOSES  - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
In a world where no one sleeps, Mela is the only one who dreams. By day, she runs a café. By night, she battles monsters in her dreams, gathering mysterious memory flowers to bring forgotten memories back to life.

Discover HIPS N NOSES, a café management sim blended with roguelike action. Listen to your customers, uncover clues to their tastes, and serve drinks made from the ingredients you collect in dreams. Decorate your café, grow stronger, and unravel the stories of a sleepless world—one cup at a time.

Brew by day. Battle by night. Rediscover what was forgotten.

Wishlist & try the demo: HIPS N NOSES on Steam

Developer: PepperStones
X: @Pepper_Stones

#HIPSNNOSES #IndieGame #OfficialTrailer
